questions.promptEn:
01 Listen and Talk

B: Jisu, what are you doing?
G: I'm looking at socks. I want to buy a pair.
B: Which ones do you like?
G: I like the ones with the red hearts, but there are two types.
B: Which do you prefer, the short ones or the long ones?
G: Um... I prefer the long ones to the short ones. So, I'll take this pair.

Jisu decided not to buy any socks today.

questions.promptEn:
02 Listen and Talk

B: I need a smartphone case. But there are so many cases here!
G: Yes, there are. Which do you prefer?
B: Hmm... I'm not sure. Can you recommend one?
G: Sure! I think the one with the cloud pattern would look great on your phone.
B: I like that one, too. I'll get it then. Thank you!

The girl thinks the cloud pattern case is a good choice.

questions.promptEn:
03 Listen and Talk

G: Hello. I'd like to buy a bag.
M: Okay. We have two colors, white and black. Which do you prefer?
G: I prefer white to black.
M: Then you can choose between these two bags.
G: They both look nice. Can you recommend one for me?
M: How about the one with the flower on it? It's popular with our customers.
G: That looks good. I'll take that one.

The girl likes the white bag more than the black one.

questions.promptEn:
04 Listen and Talk

W: Hi. Can I help you?
B: Yes, please. I'd like to exchange this green cap. I bought it yesterday, but the color doesn't look good on me.
W: Okay. Which color would you like instead?
B: Can you recommend another color for me?
W: Sure. I think this white one and the brown one are nice. Which do you prefer?
B: I like both. Can I try them on?
W: Of course. You can look in this mirror.
B: Okay.... Oh, I really like this brown one. I'll take it!
W: Okay, I'll get you a new one.
B: Thank you.

The boy bought the green cap two days ago.

questions.promptEn:
05 Listen and Talk

B: Hi, Ginny. Wow! You have a lot of things for sale!
G: Yeah. I brought some things from home. My family doesn't use them anymore.
B: I see. Actually, I need a cup. Can you recommend a good one?
G: Sure. How about a large cup?
B: That would be great.
G: Okay. Which do you prefer, a plastic one or a glass one?
B: I prefer a glass one to a plastic one. How much is the glass one?
G: It's three dollars, but I can give you a discount. How about two dollars?
B: That's a good price. Here's the money.

The original price of the glass cup is three dollars.

questions.promptEn:
06 Listen and Talk

A: I have a watch and an umbrella for sale.
B: Oh, I like both. But I can only buy one.
A: I see. Which one do you prefer?
B: I prefer the watch. How much is it?
A: It's 5,000 won, but I can give you a 10 percent discount.
B: Great! I'll take it.

Speaker A has to pay 5,000 won for the watch.

questions.promptEn:
07 Listen and Talk

G: Hi, Jinho! What are you doing?
B: Hi, Minji! I'm trying to buy shoes online. Can you help me?
G: Sure! Hmm... There are sneakers and boots. Which do you prefer?
B: I like both, so I can't decide. Can you recommend one?
G: How about sneakers? They go well with all kinds of clothes.
B: That's true! What color should I choose?
G: I think the black ones look better.
B: That sounds good! I'll buy them then. Thanks for your help!

Minji recommends the white sneakers to Jinho.
